content: BetterTweetDeck (eramdam/BetterTweetDeck), the most mature precedent for a heavy content-script extension decorating a Twitter React SPA, uses an inject.js script injected into the host page to bridge content-script and page context, and renders injected UI (settings page and some in-page UI) with React/dom-chef mounted into portal nodes attached beside or inside native elements, rather than mutating React's own vdom-owned nodes directly. This confirms the general pattern: never mutate nodes React itself manages/re-renders; instead find a stable, low-churn parent (e.g. the action-bar row container) and append a sibling wrapper element that React does not touch because it lies outside the React tree's own children reconciliation for that subtree (or is marked so via a stable key attribute it does not diff).
